output.sparql:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?label WHERE {
  wd:Q10520 rdfs:label ?label .
  ?label rdfs:lang ?lang .
  FILTER ( CONTAINS( ?lang , 'en' ) )
}
